strap: Elixir's weekly read of the Path of Legends top 100
subject: You can gain 263 rating and still fall 89 places
preheader: Path of Legends, Season 136, week of Sep 12–18.
body_markdown:
**Last Friday, 2253 rating led the world. Today it wouldn't crack the top 100.**

The board has inflated by roughly 450 points in seven days. Season 136 is
filling in, and almost everyone in the top 100 gained. That makes rank movement
a story about pace, not performance.

## The podium

**1. Hypno ❤️ Hans — 2699.** Was #2 a week ago at 2247. The only player to hold
a top-3 place all week.

**2. JTR_CR — 2694.** Wasn't in the top 200 last Friday. Entered and went
straight to second.

**3. AK Tanjiro — 2689.** Climbed from #44 to #3, adding 625 rating.

The top is tight: 10 points separate #1 from #3, and 63 points cover the whole
top 10.

**The clan story:** four of the top 33 play for YT: Hypno Cr — ranks 1, 4, 9
and 33. Sup Gskk Kiddaa has three. No other clan has more than two.

## Biggest drops

| Player | Rank | Rating |
|---|---|---|
| YouTube. KAi_CR | 6 → 95 | +263 |
| Pompeyo4.1 | 11 → 96 | +279 |
| CHI Pompeyo4 | 14 → 78 | +319 |
| Barti | 38 → 97 | +358 |
| SK Morten | 18 → 71 | +346 |

Look at the second column. **Every player on the drop list gained rating.** They
fell because the field climbed faster. In a filling season, standing still is
losing ground, and only a stored history shows you which one you're doing.

**Off the board:** Night graveyard, 5th last Friday, is no longer in the top
100.

## The deep cut: what a weekly snapshot misses

RamboOo went from #134 to #64 this week. A simple week-over-week diff would
call that a modest climb and move on.

Here's what actually happened: RamboOo reached **#1 on Tuesday** at 2586 rating,
after gaining 575 points in four days, then lost 89 points and 63 places over
the next two.

A whole run at the top, invisible in the weekly delta. The daily record is the
only reason we can tell you about it.
